title: 分割フロート式浮桟橋ユニット
description: 運河沿いや小規模マリーナの水際に配置する浮桟橋の外観ユニット。隙間を設けた個別デッキ板、外周フレームと横桁・縦桁・下面斜材、四つの独立した密閉フロート外形、保持金具、側面緩衝帯、実際に穴の開いた端部連結金具を備えます。水面、岸、係留索、船や隣接ユニットは含みません。浮力、波追従、連結動作、耐荷重、耐食性や安全性は検証していない静的な外観モデルです。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）2.223 × 0.723 × 3.610 m、22,020三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A floating-dock appearance section for canal edges and small marina scenes. It has individual gapped deck planks, perimeter framing, transverse joists, longitudinal stringers and underside diagonal braces, four separate sealed-float exteriors, retaining hardware, side rub strips and genuinely apertured end connection lugs. No water, shore, mooring line, boat or adjoining section is included. Buoyancy, wave response, connection movement, loading, corrosion resistance and safety have not been validated; this is a static appearance model. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 2.223 × 0.723 × 3.610 m; 22,020 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
